warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background — the foundational warm off-white that gives the whole interface its sunlit, lived-in feel

pristine-surface.$description: Pristine Surface — Elevated card surfaces, navigation bar, product card backgrounds, pill button fills

sand-beige.$description: Sand Beige — Secondary card surfaces and warm-toned background panels for product grouping and featured sections

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, and the brand wordmark — defines the entire typographic system

coral-pulse.$description: Coral Pulse — Bestseller badges, promotional card backgrounds, price callouts, and active accents — the singular warm energy that breaks the cream monochrome

supreme-ll-tt.$description: Primary brand typeface used for all UI text, headings, navigation, buttons, and product labels — geometric sans with uniformly tight -0.05em tracking gives the type a compact, modern rhythm; weight 400 handles body and most labels while weight 700 drives headings and product names

times.$description: Fallback or system-rendered text where Supreme LL TT is unavailable
